description: Official Japan regional minimum wage (JPY/hour) in force on a date (JST) for one prefecture, or all 47 if pref is omitted. Handles staggered FY2026 effective dates and returns the next pending revision plus overtime/night premium rules, with MHLW source URLs. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

pref.description: JIS code 1-47 (e.g. 13) or English/Japanese name (e.g. Tokyo, 東京都). Omit for all 47.

name: get_japan_minimum_wage
